messages:
alex_k: hey folks — just trying to land my first PR but hitting a lint/test failure locally. any quick pointers?

mira: welcome! can you paste the failing output? usually it's either pre-commit hooks or test DB not seeded.

alex_k: sure — running `./dev.sh test` yields:
```
ERROR: 1 failed, 23 passed
E   AssertionError: expected 200 but got 500
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/routes/test_users.py", line 27, in test_get_user
    assert resp.status_code == 200
```
not sure where to look.

taylor: pinging a couple things — did you run `./scripts/setup_dev_db.sh` after pulling? missing fixtures often cause 500s in our integration tests.

alex_k: i ran setup_dev_db but forgot to run migrations, good call. running `./manage migrate` now.

onboarding-bot: tip: New dev checklist -> https://intra.redwood.com/devex/newdev-checklist (includes setup commands, linter rules, and commit msg template) :rocket:

mira: also check `git status` — if you have local API key stubbed incorrectly tests hit 500s. We keep a `.env.example` in the repo.

alex_k: ok that fixed the test but pre-commit still blocks me on style: `black` changed some files. Should I commit those changes or reformat?
taylor: commit the formatting changes. Our policy is to commit `black`/`isort` results, not to tweak them. For PRs: small, focused, and include a short description of the change + which API route it touches.
mira: reviewers: you should add @taylor and the owning-team (see CODEOWNERS). For infra/ops touches add @eng-infra. If it's just docs add the `docs` label and ping `devex`.

alex_k: quick Q about branch naming: are we using `feature/` or `user/` prefixes?
mira: use `feature/<short-desc>` for new features, `fix/` for bugfixes, `chore/` for infra or dep bumps. Keep it under ~50 chars.

ci-bot: Heads up — CI will run on push. If you see `flake8` errors in CI but not locally, ensure your editor isn't skipping the repo's virtualenv.

alex_k: thanks all — will push the formatted changes and open a draft PR for review. Any guidance on PR size?
taylor: aim for < 300 changed lines when possible. If you need bigger, split into logical commits and explain the plan in the PR description.
mira: and add the `first-pr` label if you want a friendly reviewer. I'll take a look after you open it. :wave:
